Hazardous.description: Hazardous materials including batteries, e-waste, solvents, paints, and chemicals requiring specialized disposal.
Hazardous.handling_instructions: Do NOT place in municipal landfills or general recycling. Store in leak-proof containers and hand over to certified e-waste or hazmat collection centers.

Non-Recyclable.description: Contaminated ceramics, styrofoam (EPS), sanitary products, or multi-laminate plastics that cannot be remanufactured.
Non-Recyclable.handling_instructions: Sort into non-recyclable solid waste streams. Where possible, seek mechanical downcycling or clean energy recovery.

Organic.description: Biodegradable organic biomass, food offcuts, egg shells, yard waste, and compostable organic matter.
Organic.handling_instructions: Ideal for aerobic composting, vermicomposting, or community anaerobic biodigesters to produce nutrient-rich bio-fertilizer.

Recyclable.description: High-purity secondary commodities: clean cardboard, paper packaging, glass containers, metal cans, and rigid plastics.
Recyclable.handling_instructions: Rinse clean, compact if possible, and list on GreenLoop Marketplace for remanufacturers, upcyclers, and artisans.
